name: What are the common signs of mold in an apartment?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs of mold in an apartment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mold often appears as discolored patches on walls, ceilings, floors, or around windows, and can be green, black, white, or orange. You might also notice a musty, earthy odor, even if you can't see the mold. Other signs include peeling paint or wallpaper, persistent dampness, or condensation on surfaces. If you experience unexplained respiratory issues, allergies, or skin irritation, and these symptoms improve when you leave the apartment, mold could be a contributing factor. Early detection is crucial for effective removal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common signs of mold include visible discolored patches, a musty odor, peeling paint, or persistent dampness. Unexplained respiratory issues or allergies can also be indicators.
